   - The code block that sets an error message (`NL_SET_ERR_MSG_MOD(extack, "Eswitch vport is disabled");`) when the E-switch vport is disabled has been removed. 
   - This change prevents the logging of an extack error message when querying the hardware address of a disabled vport.

### Relationships Between Modifications

- The modification addresses a specific issue where an error log was incorrectly generated when attempting to query the hardware address of a disabled E-switch vport. By removing the error message, the patch ensures that the system does not log unnecessary errors in scenarios where querying the hardware address is unsupported due to the vport being disabled. This change improves the clarity of error logging and avoids confusion for users and developers.

        Root cause:
        The bug was caused by the system attempting to query the hardware address of an E-switch vport that is disabled, which is unsupported. This resulted in an unnecessary error log message being generated, indicating that the vport was disabled, even though this is expected behavior when the vport is not active.
        
        Commit message:
        net/mlx5: E-switch, Avoid extack error log for disabled vport

When E-switch vport is disabled, querying its hardware address is
unsupported.
Avoid setting extack error log message in such case.

Fixes: f099fde16db3 ("net/mlx5: E-switch, Support querying port function mac address")
Signed-off-by: Parav Pandit <parav@nvidia.com>
Reviewed-by: Roi Dayan <roid@nvidia.com>
Signed-off-by: Saeed Mahameed <saeedm@nvidia.com>  
        
        Patch:
        diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/eswitch.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/eswitch.c
index 6e6a9a563992..e8e6294c7cca 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/eswitch.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/mellanox/mlx5/core/eswitch.c
@@ -1902,8 +1902,6 @@ int mlx5_devlink_port_function_hw_addr_get(struct devlink *devlink,
 		ether_addr_copy(hw_addr, vport->info.mac);
 		*hw_addr_len = ETH_ALEN;
 		err = 0;
-	} else {
-		NL_SET_ERR_MSG_MOD(extack, "Eswitch vport is disabled");
 	}
 	mutex_unlock(&esw->state_lock);
 	return err;
